HeizungPage.heroTitle: Which system is the right one for me?
HeizungPage.intro: The selection of heating systems today is large, so finding the right system for a specific project can be challenging. Object size, costs for systems and associated installations, as well as legal regulations also play an important role.
HeizungPage.airWaterDesc: The most popular of all heat pumps. Used not only as central heating but also as a hot water system. Extracts heat from the outside air for more efficient performance.
HeizungPage.waterWaterDesc: The most efficient of all heat pump systems. Requires two wells (extraction and return) as well as geological analyses and special permits.
HeizungPage.geoDesc: High-efficiency heat pumps. Installation requires deep drilling of 100 to 220m. Absorbs energy through the probe.
HeizungPage.biomassDesc: Wood is a sustainable energy source and relieves the environment. Ideal for older buildings with high flow temperatures and is considered CO2-neutral.
HeizungPage.solarDesc: Solar energy is free and clean. Combining solar technology with heat pumps is a way to greatly reduce heating costs.
HeizungPage.serviceDesc: We fix your problem: burner service (oil and gas), exhaust systems, solar heating systems, underfloor heating, and radiators.

SanitaerPage.intro: Plumbing installations combine a wide world of style, colors, and shapes with technical installations. From simple to highly complex, the plan is not limited to piping systems, but also includes the design of the object and the end-use requirements.
SanitaerPage.sectorsDesc: Our experience extends beyond the private sector to plumbing installations in commercial, industrial, and judicial facilities. As a specialist company, we support you competently in all questions regarding plumbing facilities. We ensure optimal planning and are happy to advise you on furnishing your premises.

KlimaPage.intro: Air conditioners are often confused with ventilation. While some air conditioners do ventilate, this is not always the case. So what exactly is the difference?
KlimaPage.klimaDesc: Refers to cooling or heating as well as the strict control of humidity in a room.
KlimaPage.lueftungDesc: Refers to the continuous circulation of fresh air between the indoors and outdoors.
KlimaPage.detailsText: Certain types of air conditioning systems are designed to introduce fresh outside air to ventilate a room, while other types do not. We also offer well-being through climate solutions tailored to your situation.
